entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Improve Blazor WebAssembly AOT: trimming, reflection, System.Text.Json, and third-party library support #64802
  • Perf regression: json_middleware, multiple_queries #64800
  • Perf improvement: fortunes_dapper, fortunes_dapper #64799
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenAPI v10 sets no `type` for components #64797
  • Inconsistent behavior when passing enum values in json body #64795
  • Consider supporting `Label` in addition to `DisplayName` #64791
    Backlog
  • ASP.NET Core roadmap for .NET 11 #64787
    11.0.0

Closed

  • Perf improvement: updates #64780
  • Perf regression: json #64792
  • A strange issue where page content is displayed with repeated overlay. #64793
  • [Blazor] OwningComponentBase Dispose method in .NET 10 differs from .NET9 #64669
    10.0.x
  • [JsonIgnore(WhenWritingDefault)] bypasses validation on inbound requests #64692

Created

  • CreateServer with TestServerOptions in WebApplicationFactory #64803
    community-contribution, needs-area-label

    area-blazor
  • Fix templatestrings in RazorClassLibrary template #64796
    area-mvc
  • [release/10.0] [Blazor] `OwningComponentBase` Dispose method in .NET 10 gets back the original behavior #64794
